subject: E-Commerce
title: Slow Shipping Options
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Slow Shipping Options.

hook.text: Amazon offers 'No-Rush Shipping' with a small credit. Choosing slower shipping reduces emissions by consolidating.

buildup.text: Same-day delivery requires individual trucks racing to meet deadlines. No-rush allows batch deliveries on efficient.

discovery.text: When shoppers choose slower delivery, emissions per package drop 30%. Patience is genuinely more sustainable.

twist.text: Only 15% of shoppers voluntarily choose slow shipping. Convenience consistently wins over environmental concern.

climax.text: Slow shipping is the easiest way to reduce e-commerce emissions. But consumers won't choose it without stronger.

punchline.text: 30% fewer emissions, 15% choose it. The easiest green option is rejected by.

quiz.question: Why does slow shipping reduce emissions by 30%?
options: It allows batch deliveries on efficient routes instead of individual rushed trips
